कैवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A fisherman born of a prostitute by a Kṣatriya, or of
an Ayogava female by a Nisada father.
 f. (-र्त्ती) The wife of a
fisherman.
 E. क water, the seventh case, के and वर्त्त who abides,
केवर्त्त a fish, अण् affix, implying enmity.
कैवर्त्तमुस्तक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass: see the next.

कैवर्त्तिमुस्तक n. (-कं) A fragrant kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E.
कैवर्त्त as above, water-abiding, and मुस्तक cyperus; also कैवर्त्तीमुस्तक,
कैवर्त्तमुस्त, &c.

कैवल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्यी-ल्यं) Sole, only.
 n. (-ल्यं)
 1. Eternal emancipation,
future happiness.
 2. Exclusiveness, individuality.
 E. केवल alone,
free from all fetters, ष्यञ् affix of the abstract.
